diffs.patch:
Index: .github/workflows/release.yml
===================================================================
--- .github/workflows/release.yml	
+++ .github/workflows/release.yml	
@@ -1,16 +1,25 @@
 name: Release
 on:
   push:
     tags:
       - 'v*'
+permissions:
+  contents: write
+  packages: write
 jobs:
   release:
     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
     steps:
       - uses: actions/checkout@v4
       - name: Build binary
         run: go build -o myapp .
       - name: Publish release
         uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
         with:
-          files: myapp
\ No newline at end of file
+          files: myapp
+      - name: Log in to the container registry
+        run: echo "${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" | docker login ghcr.io -u ${{ github.actor }} --password-stdin
+      - name: Build Docker image
+        run: docker build -t "ghcr.io/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY,,}:${GITHUB_REF_NAME}" .
+      - name: Push Docker image
+        run: docker push "ghcr.io/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY,,}:${GITHUB_REF_NAME}"

Index: Dockerfile
===================================================================
--- Dockerfile	
+++ Dockerfile	
@@ -0,0 +1,8 @@
+FROM golang:1.22-alpine AS build
+WORKDIR /src
+COPY . .
+RUN CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -o /out/myapp .
+
+FROM gcr.io/distroless/static-debian12
+COPY --from=build /out/myapp /myapp
+ENTRYPOINT ["/myapp"]
